metadata.notes: A compact five-entity, five-relationship sample based on Lost Mine of Phandelver. This is demonstration data, not Heartwell canon.

entities.name: Gundren Rockseeker
entities.notes: A dwarf prospector and one of the three Rockseeker brothers. He has rediscovered the lost Wave Echo Cave and is transporting supplies and information connected to the mine.

fields.Status: Missing at the start of the adventure

entities.name: Sildar Hallwinter
entities.notes: A human warrior and member of the Lords' Alliance. He accompanies Gundren toward Phandalin, is ambushed by goblins, and is taken prisoner.

entities.name: Klarg
entities.notes: A bugbear chief who commands the Cragmaw Hideout. He serves the Cragmaw goblins and is connected to the Black Spider's effort to intercept Gundren and the information he carries.

entities.name: Nezznar the Black Spider
entities.notes: A drow villain orchestrating the search for Wave Echo Cave. He uses agents and the Cragmaw goblins to locate Gundren and secure control of the mine.

entities.name: Wave Echo Cave
entities.notes: The lost mine containing the Forge of Spells. Gundren has rediscovered its location, while the Black Spider seeks to claim it.

relationships.note: Sildar is accompanying Gundren on the journey to Phandalin.
Klarg's goblins ambush Gundren's expedition and take him toward Cragmaw Castle.
Sildar is captured during the goblin ambush and held at Cragmaw Hideout.
Klarg and the Cragmaw goblins operate within the Black Spider's network.
The Black Spider wants to find and control Wave Echo Cave and the Forge of Spells.
